title: Flair lures Sting into a Horsemen trap
summary: Flair’s apparent falling-out with Arn Anderson leads him to seek Sting’s help. Sting reluctantly trusts his old enemy, only to discover that the reconciliation is a setup.

chapters.title: Anderson defeats Flair
chapters.result: Anderson defeats Flair with Pillman’s involvement.
chapters.context: The apparent fracture among the veterans lays the groundwork for Flair’s appeals to Sting.

chapters.title: The hot tag becomes a betrayal
chapters.result: Flair turns on Sting during their match against Anderson and Pillman.
chapters.context: The supposed rescue instead reunites the Horsemen against the trusting Sting.
